purpose: Privacy-safe, read-only proof contract for the legacy QĐKT Rg3 selection and canonical Case/Application/Site identity bridge.

vba_selection_trace.fact: UpdateListHistory filters by Site ID and GxP, with an optional GMP production-line filter, and collects every matching db.ktra row.
LoadMappingList compares exact values when Iden=True and returns every matching named-range row index; it does not establish uniqueness.
The displayed history list is sorted by date; the previous selected row is preserved when present, otherwise the first displayed row is selected.
Get_IdxKtra returns the selected history item's hidden db.ktra row index and btnFile passes it to RecordForm.
PrepareRecordFormData stores the selected named-range row index as Idx_Ktr.
GetTT_Ktra assigns Rg3 = Names("db_ktra").RefersToRange.Rows(Idx_Ktr), then reads NgaynopHsDK and HsDK from that exact row.
The dossier-row Rg3 is procedure-local, assigned once and released; other Rg3 locals belong to separate procedures and never assign the dossier variables.

khkt_independent_path.fact: TaoQDKT_KHKT reads an ActiveSheet planning row and invokes CreateFile with i=2 without assigning Rg3, s_MaHsDk, or s_NgaynopHsDk.
khkt_independent_path.assignment_evidence: RecordForm.frm:18 declares the dossier variables; RecordForm.frm:343 is their only assignment; RecordForm.frm:748-749 renders them.
khkt_independent_path.identity_conclusion: A KHKT ActiveSheet row does not prove a db.ktra dossier-row identity.

canonical_projection.case: Each effective db.ktra row creates one Case keyed by legacy_inspection_id and linked to the Site resolved from that same row's legacy site ID.
canonical_projection.application: The importer creates one CaseApplication for that Case and projects submitted_at and dossier_code from the same normalized db.ktra row.
canonical_projection.anchor: LegacyInspectionStorageAnchor binds a Case to the exact db.ktra physical source row and pinned source version; source_hash is checked as an additional row-evidence coordinate.
non_keys: named-range row index treated as legacy inspection ID

anchor_projection_audit.source: local read-only legacy_inspection_storage_anchor_projection.json plus its audit summary; raw projection is intentionally excluded from Git

invariants.identity_join: selected named-range row -> physical db.ktra row -> legacy inspection ID -> canonical Case -> CaseApplication and Site, with exact storage-anchor source coordinates
invariants.submission_semantics: PARTIAL: literal value projection is testable, but legacy source evidence does not resolve whether the field means submitted or received.
invariants.physical_bookmark_presence: SEPARATE_BLOCKER: record identity does not prove that HsDK/Ngaynop bookmarks exist in the approved templates.
